title: Radix pass statement
statement: The radix pass is the sequential composition of two procedure calls. The first call uses the number field, permutation field, their sum, and the five supplied key, stride, offset, bound, and counter expressions as arguments; the second uses the sum of the permutation and number fields, the permutation field, and the number field.
